purpose: Choose a small set of divergence alerts for daily discretionary reference on BTCUSDT perpetual 1D and 4H. Not a new trading strategy optimization.
signal_parameters: Keep existing Close / Regular / pivot 5 / last 10 pivots / max 100 bars / confirmation. No parameter search.
daily_context: Latest confirmed daily qualifying event; same direction remains active at most 10 calendar days. Opposite event replaces it; a simultaneous two-direction conflict clears it. No unfinished daily bar.
rationale_horizon: Daily alert: following 10 days. 4H timing/risk alert: following 3 days. Fixed before looking at this round's outcomes; do not choose a better horizon afterwards.
entry_reference: Next native-timeframe open, unadjusted market price. This is signal quality, not a cost-adjusted return or account backtest.
primary_outcome: Within the fixed horizon, does +1 signal-time ATR(14) in the indicated direction occur before -1 ATR? Both reached in same 1H candle: classify ambiguous_adverse_first. All valid events, including neither barrier reached, remain in denominator.
secondary_outcomes: median maximum favorable excursion in ATR and percent
median maximum adverse excursion in ATR and percent
independent_alerts: Within each configuration, sample the first eligible signal, then ignore new signals in either direction for the whole observation window, even after a barrier is touched. Configuration ledgers can overlap with each other, not within a ledger.
diagnostic_cohort: Also split the SAME any-signal baseline events by exact-one vs multiple indicators and by daily same/opposite/no active context. These are diagnostic subsets, not independently replayed alert settings.
regime: Last confirmed DAILY ADX(14): <20 range, >=25 trend, otherwise transition. Within trend, direction from +DI vs -DI; label alert as with/against trend. Classification is descriptive, no regime filter fitted.
boundary: Skip events whose full observation window crosses period end. Apply previous data-quality exclusions to OHLC-inconsistent execution windows.
practical_filter_standard: Treat a threshold or daily gate as supported only if full-period primary success improves >=5 percentage points, median adverse ATR does not increase, at least 35% of alerts remain, and recent-period primary success also improves. Require full sample >=30 and recent >=15; otherwise insufficient evidence. These are practical screening thresholds, not statistical proof.
uncertainty: Wilson intervals descriptive; paired group-membership and regime cohorts are dependent. No claim of fresh out-of-sample validation or multiple-comparison-adjusted significance.
pending: TradingView export reconciliation remains incomplete. No live future evidence. No indicator combinations beyond listed 12 configurations.
